1. Collect 6 spruce logs.
2. Craft 4 spruce planks using those 6 spruce logs (each plank takes 2 logs).

4. Gather 6 sticks. We already have the 4 stick recipe, but we still need 2 more.
5. Craft 1 more stick using 2 bamboo.
6. Now we have all the ingredients for crafting spruce sign: 6 spruce planks and 6 sticks.
7. Craft 3 spruce sign using exactly these 6 spruce planks. Each sign requires 2 spruce planks, so we get one sign right away.
8. The last part is just to ensure we have enough components to complete it entirely.
9. If any sign remains incomplete (which isn't supposed to happen with exactly 6 parts), simply repeat the sign crafting process from step 7 until fully completed.

The final sequence of steps to achieve this goal is:

2. Use 6 logs to make 4 spruce planks.
3. Obtain 2 more sticks.
4. Craft another stick using 2 bamboo.
5. You now have 6 spruce planks and 6 sticks.
6. Craft 3 signs using these materials.
